name: Coffin
lod_rule: each LOD from the full model, its cells lined up on the pivot; a cell is kept when half filled or half covered seen along an axis (thin shafts and spokes survive)
units: glTF metres, +Y up, the model facing +Z; 1 voxel = 1.5 cm
material: point-sampled atlas: base colour, metallic-roughness (metal in B, roughness in G), emission
ambient_occlusion: COLOR_0, linear, multiplies the base colour (1.0, 0.8, 0.64, 0.5 for 0..3 cells)
